_doc: PW-6818 end-to-end accuracy cases. Each case drives the FULL chain: config(1.1) -> questions -> answers -> criteria -> criteria_to_filters(1.2) -> mutations -> search(2.1) -> results. 'expect' is a declarative DSL consumed by e2e_checks.normalize_filters + check_filters/check_results. Fields are optional; only what is stated is asserted. family = filter dimension under test; size = prompt-length bucket.

_dsl.filters.<field>: {includes:[..], excludes:[..], empty:true, nonempty:true, equals:X, min:N, max:N, country_scope:[..], bucket:'must'|'should'|'must_not'}
_dsl.results: {min_total:N, max_total:N, zero_ok:true, location_country:'..', location_any:[..], title_any:[..], skill_any:[..], must_not_skill:[..], company_any:[..], min_frac:0.7}
_dsl.unsupported: constraints we know the schema cannot express — presence in query but absence in filters is reported as SILENT-DROP, not a pass

senior python developer in Pune
We need a backend engineer with strong Python and PostgreSQL skills, based in Bangalore, ideally 5+ years of experience building REST APIs.

Hiring a Senior Data Engineer in Hyderabad. You will build and own batch and streaming pipelines, model warehouse schemas, and partner with analytics. What we look for: strong Python and SQL, hands-on Spark and Airflow, cloud data warehouse experience (Snowflake or BigQuery), and 6-9 years in data engineering. Kafka and dbt are a bonus.

Nimbus Data Labs is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) for our Bengaluru office. About the role: you will design, build and operate REST APIs and event-driven services in Python (FastAPI and Django), own services end to end across design, implementation, deployment and monitoring, and partner with product and data teams to ship reliable features at scale. Responsibilities include architecting microservices on AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3), designing relational schemas and tuning PostgreSQL, building CI/CD pipelines with Docker, instrumenting observability, and mentoring two junior engineers. Requirements: 5-8 years backend experience, expert Python, strong SQL and data modeling, hands-on AWS, Docker and CI/CD, and a track record shipping production systems. Nice to have: Terraform, Kafka, Redis, GraphQL and B2B SaaS experience. Hybrid, three days onsite.
cases.note: under the 1000-char cap; hiring company (Nimbus Data Labs) must NOT become a candidate company filter

cases.query: Aurora Systems is recruiting a Staff Platform Engineer to join our infrastructure organisation in Chennai, India. The platform group owns the internal developer platform used by more than two hundred engineers across four product lines, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. You will design and operate multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters, build golden paths and paved roads for service teams, own the CI/CD toolchain end to end, define and enforce reliability standards through SLOs and error budgets, and drive a multi-year migration from virtual machines to containers. Day to day you will write Go and Python, author Terraform modules, review architecture proposals from product teams, run incident reviews, and mentor senior engineers on operational excellence. We expect nine or more years of infrastructure engineering experience, deep hands-on Kubernetes in production at meaningful scale, expertise with at least one major cloud provider, fluency in infrastructure as code, and a demonstrated record of leading complex technical migrations across many teams. You should be comfortable writing design documents, negotiating scope with product leadership, and making pragmatic tradeoffs under real constraints. Nice to have: service mesh experience, eBPF, cost optimisation at scale, prior platform team leadership, and open source contributions. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, comprehensive health cover, an annual learning budget, and a hybrid working arrangement with three days per week in our Chennai office.
